newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid air cargo traffic flat in September.
newsitem.headline: Madrid air cargo traffic flat in September.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Madrid's Barajas airport was practically unchanged in September at 18,852 tonnes, just 0.2 percent lower than the same month last year, the airport authority said.
The nine month total is still 3.6 percent ahead of 1995 at 174,197 tonnes, mainly thanks to stronger domestic traffic.
National charter traffic and international scheduled cargo were the only categories to show modest growth last month, all others declined.
International cargo accounted for 13,484 tonnes and domestic for 5,368.
Passenger numbers rose nearly eight percent to 2.04 million and there were 11 percent more aircraft movements or 21,601 in total.
